programme.title: Citas Letales
programme.desc: En 2012, cuando Nadine Aburas de Cardiff conoció al neoyorquino Sammy Almahri en un sitio de citas musulmán, parecía carismático. En julio de 2014, Nadine vio un lado diferente de él.

programme.title: Citas Letales
programme.desc: Ashley Pegram era madre de tres niños pequeños. Su mundo se vino abajo cuando su pareja murió en un accidente automovilístico. Ashley, sola y deprimida, comenzó a usar aplicaciones de citas para conocer chicos.

programme.title: Citas Letales
programme.desc: Al encontrarse sola por primera vez en muchos años después de la muerte de su esposo, Lorraine, de 62 años, decidió probar las citas online. En el 2009 conoció a Robert Wiesner. Pero amigos y familiares tenían dudas sobre el nuevo hombre.

programme.title: Citas Letales
programme.desc: Sharon Siermans, de 29 años, estaba buscando el amor cuando comenzó a chatear online con un hombre llamado Jason Godfrey. Acordaron su primera cita, pero cuando Sharon lo conoció en la estación de tren, no se parecía en nada a lo que era.

programme.title: Citas Letales
programme.desc: Kayleigh Haywood tenía 15 años cuando Luke Harlow, de 27 años, la contactó inesperadamente online. Él la bombardeó con mensajes, diciéndole que era bonita, especial y que él debería ser su novio.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: Illis pretende poner un micrófono en casa de su hermana pero el aparato se le cae; lo busca y Elisenda se acerca.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: Israel exige a Pastora que salga de su casa; la mujer hace saber que Illis se hizo pasar por ella.

Transición de dos años – Lorena finalizó sus estudios de medicina y está de guardia en la emergencia de un hospital. Paco aparece allí para decirle que está dispuesto a decir todo lo que sabe y la joven reacciona decepcionada de que él pretenda revelar la verdad después de tanto tiempo; sin embargo quiere escuchar lo que él vino a decirle.

Gertrudis llama a Michelle para que se deshaga del cuerpo sin vida de Paco. Para ella fue muy fácil matar por segunda vez, al punto de sentirse muy tranquila y afirmar que de esa manera resuelve los problemas con gran rapidez. Norma descubre todo, pero no está dispuesta a ser cómplice de un asesinato - Omar recibe una llamada que lo descompone, unos agentes de la policía encontraron el cadáver de Paco.

programme.title: Corazon Traicionado
programme.desc: Lorena renuncia en la casa de los Corona. Ricardo sigue aturdido por su madre con lo referente al millón de dólares que perdieron. Lorena; entre los anaqueles del anticuario descubre la figura de Gertrudis hablando con el delincuente, confirmando así su terrible sospecha de que es la propia madre de Alberto la que quiere acabar con la vida de su esposo, Marco Aurelio Corona.

programme.title: Corazon Traicionado
programme.desc: Pedro promete a Gertrudis que el trabajo se hará esa noche, pero a su manera: con una inyección letal. Ricardo comienza a enredarse en su propia telaraña con María Bonita y parece olvidarse de su objetivo: descubrir a la mujer que cobró el cheque de su madre. Virginia saca cuentas y se percata de que tiene un retraso en su período menstrual. Gertrudis intenta entusiasmar a Patricia conquistar a Alberto.

programme.title: La Trepadora
programme.desc: Hilario quiere que Adelaida lo acompañe a Cantarrana para que convenza a Victoria de que regrese a la capital y deje de sabotear la hacienda, pues con eso solo se está poniendo en peligro; la señora acepta acompañarlo porque se trata de su hija. Victoria se compadece de Federico cuando éste, conteniendo el llanto, admite que fue él quien asesinó a su papá. Nicolás llega a la hacienda con Victoria prendida en fiebre y desvanecida; el joven explica a Adelaida y Fernanda que la encontró sola en medio del camino y ya ordenó a varios peones que fueran en busca de Federico; la señora Alcoy, que no aprueba que la muchacha haya sido llevada hasta la que ahora es su casa, no puede dejar de avergonzarse cuando Adelaida le reprocha su falta de humanidad.

programme.title: La Trepadora
programme.desc: Hilario quiere ir con Nicolás a buscar a Federico y Fernanda, furiosa, advierte a su medio hermano que no va a venderle Cantarrana como quiere para que aprenda a vivir como el don nadie que es. Victoria le confía a Clementina que sabe que si Federico mató a Leopoldo fue por cosas que ella hizo y eso la hacía sentir que tenía una deuda con él, pero ahora no le debe nada porque le salvó la vida; sin embargo, ella está consciente de que los Del Casal y ella son enemigos a muerte y solo le queda esperar cuál será el próximo muerto en esa guerra.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Octavia, ayuda a Astrid en la preparación del matrimonio y disfruta pensando en lo que Camila siente. Esta y Max, muy dolidos sabe que deben olvidarse. Fausto, insiste en que Roger y Fernando planifiquen la muerte de Ezequiel.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Marcelina, familiares y el juez se preocupan por la ausencia de Max. Astrid acusa a Camila de estar de acuerdo para hacerla pasar este mal rato. Llega el novio, bebido y ayudado por Ezequiel. Firman sus votos matrimoniales. A los meses, Astrid, estresada, púes desea un hijo para asegurar la fortuna. Ezequiel, sin resultados, queriendo enamorar a Camila.

programme.desc: Ingmar Griepenkerl is found shot dead in one of Lübeck's many parks.

programme.desc: Finn y Lars son llamados a asistir a un caso del Escuadrón de Secuestros de la Oficina de Policía Criminal del Estado.

programme.desc: En un lugar de demolición, Jan Steinert, un hombre sin hogar, observa a un hombre que huye de la policía y le esconde una bolsa de deporte verde.

programme.title: Cenk Batu: Agente Encubierto
programme.desc: La LKA, la Oficina Estatal Alemana de Investigación Criminal, envía a Cenk Batu de incógnito como el oficial de relaciones con la prensa Sinan Afra para rastrear a un espía industrial.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E02: El Despertar
programme.desc: Randy y Marcy viven bajo un estrés real todos los días; ambos trabajan en agencias de la policía. Randy trabaja como detective, mientras que Marcy maneja el centro de llamadas. Pero en 2003, el estrés aumenta cuando el Ejército envía en misión especial a su hijo al Medio Oriente. Marcy se siente abrumada por la preocupación. Cuando alcanza su punto de quiebre emocional, un espíritu latente despierta para amenazarla. Los miedos de Marcy solo sirven para alimentar al espíritu colérico, hasta que éste se vuelve sobrecogedoramente poderoso. Marcy debe luchar para mantener la calma y tratar de encontrar la manera de librar a su hogar de esa presencia maligna antes de ésta la lleve al límite.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S08E14 Guarida del demonio
programme.desc: Una familia cree que tiene un fantasma inofensivo en su casa hasta que comienza a amenazar a los niños. No queriendo dejar que el mal gane, la familia recurre a la Iglesia Católica para expulsar al demonio.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E07: Hechizo
programme.desc: Sandra Waldron encuentra fascinante el reino de lo sobrenatural. Pero su hijo adolescente, Gene, no comparte ese entusiasmo. Cuando se enteran de que su casa está embrujada, Sandra se embarca en una cruzada para aprender más acerca de lo paranormal. Aunque Gene se preocupa por la seguridad de Sandra, ella le asegura que no hay nada que temer. Pronto, Sandra se adentra más y más en lo oculto. Gene se niega a formar parte de eso; entonces, se gradúa de la escuela secundaria y se une a las fuerzas militares, con el fin de escapar de los nuevos intereses de su madre. Ahora solitaria y perdida, Sandra encuentra consuelo en la religión Wicca. Ella intenta realizar ceremonias Wiccas para atraer la buena fortuna a su vida. Pero cuando su falta de conocimiento sobre ese arte la lleva a abrir de forma involuntaria un portal paranormal, entonces Sandra debe combatir el mal que se ha desatado.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E06: Donde Habita El Mal
programme.desc: Poco después de que la familia Shea se muda a una casa antigua en el estado de Arkansas, algunos sonidos escalofriantes y ciertas voces fantasmales atraviesan la tranquila noche campestre. Los Shea descubren que un joven murió en esa casa. Entonces, atribuyen la juguetona actividad paranormal al fantasma del joven. Pero su alivio en poco tiempo abre paso a un terror escalofriante, en el momento en que una amenaza más tenebrosa se manifiesta, con la intención de hacerle daño a su familia. Cuando uno de sus hijos sufre una terrible herida, los Shea deciden no correr el riesgo de que esa presencia maligna sea la causante de los problemas. Temiendo por la seguridad de sus hijos, los Shea recurren a espiritistas psíquicos, quienes se enfrentarán su propia experiencia aterradora, mientras intentan luchar contra el mal que acecha en su interior.

programme.desc: Cabe pensar que en la época comunista de Europa del Este solo había coches como el Trabant, el Wartburg o el Lada. Sin embargo, compañías como Tatra de Checoslovaquia introdujeron automóviles avanzados, incluso pioneros. Echamos un vistazo a algunos de estos coches clásicos, como un singular Tatra T87 de 1937, un Wartburg 311 y 312 y un Skoda 110R.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Porsche 911 Targa es un clásico y un buen ejemplo de descapotable emblemático. Y además: el ligero Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS es más para una carrera que un vehículo de carretera normal; el Bentley de 1930 de 4,5 litros Bentley es el Santo Grial de la exclusiva marca británica; el Sunbeam Tiger: un motor V8 de Ford USA propulsa este coche inglés de alto rendimiento un tanto delicado.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Ford Fairlane GTA de 1967 en la NASCAR no puede ser más americano. Y además: en 1995 el Chrysler 300 C fue el vehículo en serie más potente de los EE.UU. y fue apodado "The Bankers' Hot Rod". Y además: visitamos una de las mayores colecciones de Mopar del mundo; el Cadillac Serie 62 descapotable de 1949 estableció nuevos estándares de lujo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Land's End en Cornwall y John O'Groats en Escocia forman el punto de partida y de llegada del Rallye Le Jog, considerado por muchos el rally de coches clásicos más duro del mundo. Acompañamos a un equipo femenino alemán en este desafío con su Volkswagen Iltis todoterreno. Y también: el Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947, una reminiscencia de los tiempos de "Miss Marple"; el Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Jeep Willys
programme.desc: En 1940, la Segunda Guerra Mundial hace estragos. Los Estados Unidos no participan directamente al principio, pero proporcionan recursos. Reconocen la necesidad de vehículos de transporte ligero y se deciden por el concepto de Willys Overland Motors.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz Renntransporter
programme.desc: El equipo de Mercedes Classic ha revivido un mito con la reconstrucción del transportador de coches "Renntransporter". Al igual que en el pasado, el transportador azul lleva el coche del campeonato mundial de 1955, el W196, en su parte trasera.

programme.desc: En la cena, el tema principal será Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel dice que esa mujer fue una oportunista que enamoró y se aprovechó de su hermano menor, Leoncio. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto le pide a Astrid que le consiga un trabajo en Mascarada a cambio de no hacer nada contra Max. Camila confiesa a Max que Roberto la chantajea. Luciano y el inspector interrogan a la Madre Isabel y al Padre Tiziano sobre Rosa Blanco y ellos mienten.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel defiende a Camila de la acusación de Roberto y confronta a Camila. Max, al encontrarla muy triste, le pide que confíe en él. Julia y Gregorio con un plan para que sus padres piensen que no volverán a verse y dejen de seguirlos.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila se defiende fieramente de la agresión de Roberto y le cuenta a Max lo sucedido. La Madre Isabel, para ayudar a Camila, le confía a Ezequiel el motivo por el que Roberto la extorsiona. Max presiona a Camila para que le cuente toda la verdad.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sunny was enraged when she learned her mom, Carolyn, was adopting Sunny’s 36-year-old ex-boyfriend, Chris, and begged her to not go through with the process. Now that the adoption is final, she says Carolyn puts more time and energy into her relationship with Chris than into their mother-daughter bond. Carolyn says she always wanted a son and was over-the-moon when she finally adopted Chris. She says no parent has to ask their child for permission to have more children, so why should she need Sunny’s approval to adopt Chris? Carolyn and Sunny see each other for the first time in more than six months on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Sunny move past her feelings of betrayal, and can Dr. Phil help them mend their broken bond? Then, why did Chris, a married father of three, want to be adopted?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In-laws can be the kind who give unwanted advice, stop by unexpectedly and use guilt and manipulation to get what they want. But sometimes, they are loving parents who get caught in the middle of their child's relationship. Amanda calls her mother-in-law, Yolande, psychotic, controlling and meddling. She says Yolande speaks to her son, Pierre, in French so she can hide the hurtful words she’s using about Amanda. Yolande says Amanda is a drunk, and an uneducated woman who is wrecking her son's life. Why does Pierre say he can't choose a side? To test Amanda's theory of why Yolande and Pierre speak French to each other, Dr. Phil sets up a "special" dinner for the three of them. Be a fly on the wall, and find out if Amanda's right or just being paranoid. And, John and Chrissy's engagement is on hold because they say they can't stop fighting. They hit and slap each other, and call each other vulgar names — often in front of their 8-month-old son. John's mom, Charlene, who is often pulled into their fights, says they both need to grow up! After watching themselves scream and yell on tape, will this couple decide to drop their fists, close their mouths and work to make a peaceful home for their baby?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents: How well do you know your teen? Could your daughter be indulging in harmful activities right beneath your nose? Anna says she was outraged when she discovered her daughter, Allie’s, secret addiction to prescription pills. Allie maintains that she’s been clean for four months, but Anna doesn’t believe her. She says the 19-year-old has been involved in three car accidents in the past seven months, and the police recently brought her home for erratic driving. Does Allie still have a problem with prescription meds? Will she agree to take a drug test? Then, 17 year-old Elizabeth wrote in to the Teen Talk forum because she says she’s leading a double life. She says her secret is eating her up inside, and she wants to confess to her parents. Find out what the young woman’s been hiding, and see how her folks respond when she drops the bombshell.

Why does she say she blames herself for what happened? And, hear from Amanda’s parents, Juliet and Timothy, who say they just want their daughter to move on. When Dr. Phil gives Amanda a harsh dose of reality, will she see the situation for what it is? Then, 18-year-old Seri says that two years ago, she fell in love with 26-year-old Hector, who convinced her to quit school and become a prostitute — and give him all the profits. Hector was convicted of sexual assault of a child and is now serving up to 30 years in prison. Seri is raising their daughter and has a new boyfriend, Will, but she admits that she would consider taking Hector back, if given the opportunity. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Linda and Rich say their three 20-something daughters are all hooked on heroin -- and the parents disagree about how to handle the situation. Linda admits she enables her daughters by giving them money, paying their bills and providing a place to stay, but she says she just can’t kick them out -- like Rich wants to do. Dr. Phil gives the couple an uncensored look at a day in their daughters’ lives -- obtaining money at any cost, buying drugs and shooting up together. Will this be the eye-opener the parents need to stop enabling their daughters and help save their lives? And, will the siblings accept help under Dr. Phil’s one big, non-negotiable condition?

Then, Bev says she’s concerned for her sister, Melanie, who married her much younger man, Devar, after meeting him on a Jamaican vacation. Is Devar in it for love, or for a green card and money? And, Dr. Phil catches up with best-selling author Mitch Albom.

But what happens when the man is more than two decades older than his girlfriend, or the woman is 15 years older than her young lover? Forty-year-old Sanjay is a wealthy cosmetic surgeon who met 18-year-old Jacqueline on the Web site SugarDaddie.com. They’ve only been together for four months and are already talking marriage. Sanjay’s friend, Mike, is convinced that Jacqueline will put him right in the poorhouse! Is there a chance that Sanjay has found true love, or is Jacqueline just in it for the money? Then, 24-year-old Ryan is engaged to Angela, a woman 15 years his senior. Ryan’s friend, Donovan, fears that Angela is alienating Ryan from his buddies. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.sub-title: How to Fix a Broken Family
programme.desc: You've heard people complain, "If I only knew then what I know now, I wouldn't be in this mess," but what about those times when you choose not to see the writing on the wall? Dr. Phil meets couples who say their relationships went from bad to worse after they said, "I do," and now their families are broken.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nikki says her three-year marriage has turned volatile. She claims her husband, Mark, has punched her in the face, broken her nose and run over her toe with his truck -- among other allegations -- which he denies. Mark claims Nikki instigates most of their fights and has violent outbursts, and he suspects she might be trying to kill him. The couple admits their confrontations happen in front of their two young children, and both say they want to save their marriage. Dr. Phil intervenes for the sake of their kids. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Horrific allegations are tearing a family apart — but who is telling the truth? Todd says he was shocked and appalled when his ex-girlfriend's mother, Diana, accused him of molesting his 4-year-old daughter, Taniya, and turns to Dr. Phil to help clear his name. Diana says that while babysitting Taniya, the toddler detailed ways in which Todd inappropriately touched her, and she's convinced he's done the unthinkable. After learning of the accusations, Taniya's mom, Latia, reported the alleged sexual abuse to a judge who immediately stripped Todd of his parental rights — but was justice served? Latia says that as much as she wants to believe Todd's innocence, as a mother, she needs to take every precaution to protect her child. A year has passed since he's seen his daughter, and Todd says he will go to any length to prove his innocence, including taking another a lie detector test — even though he's already passed one. He's adamant that Diana is lying and says that she coached Taniya to make the accusations. Dr. Phil calls in an expert polygraph examiner. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Leoncito Alado
programme.desc: LEONCITO ALADO es un canal de canciones infantiles para niños de 1 a 3 años de edad. Aquí podrás encontrar canciones para tranquilizar, entretener y enseñar valores y talentos a nuestros pequeños espectadores.

programme.title: Pim y Pom en el Museo
programme.desc: Pim y Pom, dos gatitos, llevan a los niños a una aventura en el fascinante mundo del arte. Con la fuerza de su imaginación, exploran cuadros de artistas famosos como Vincent van Gogh, Johannes Vermeer, Rembrandt, Seurat y Renoir.

programme.title: Las aventuras de los bebés llorones Lágrimas mágicas
programme.desc: Los Bebés Llorones viven en el mundo de Lágrimas Mágicas donde aprenden juntos lo que es la amistad, el trabajo en equipo y la empatía. Disfruta con ellos aventuras increíbles en mundos llenos de magia. Cada uno de los Bebés Llorones es único, pero todos tienen algo en común: ¡sus lágrimas son mágicas!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Talking Tom descubre que su ciudad ha descendido al segundo lugar entre las ciudades mas amistosas, y el y la banda deciden que tienen que ser mas acogedores.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

Desde la confianza, humildad y el perdón, a la honestidad, responsabilidad, cooperación y dignidad. El show ayuda a los niños a comprender la importancia desde pequeños detalles como ser corteses, hasta a desarrollar grandes virtudes y habilidades, como saber toma de decisiones.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Leo Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger presenta los secretos y las maravillas de la naturaleza y la vida silvestre que nos rodea y estimula la curiosidad y la pasión por la naturaleza en los niños. Con interesantes misiones y aventuras, los niños se divierten mientras aprenden lecciones positivas.

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Nature-Inspired Crafts: Wooden Rope Seat & Slab Wood Coffee Table
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are on a paradise Pacific Island. Well, not exactly paradise, since there is a very active volcano, on which a very active Hefty Smurf risks his life as well as Smurfette's!

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every time Lazy falls asleep, he is caught in the same recurrent nightmare: he is in the power of Morphio, an evil sorcerer who wants to capture as many sleeping souls as possible. One after another, all the Smurfs are going to fall in Morphio's clutches. All of them? Well, maybe not, if Papa Smurf can help it. And Papa Smurf goes to the Sandman for help...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: Tis The Season To Be Smurfy
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: Scruple And The Great Book Of Spells
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo

But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run

Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs

Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs take Grandpa Smurf to the King's castle so that he can meet Peewit. But what with one thing and another (especially another), the Smurfs and Peewit are taken aboard a Viking long ship. The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. One is found sitting in a barn with the other trapped in an old car hauler. Upon uncovering the cars, we find both have big stories to tell.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 191
programme.desc: The segment features three diverse luxury vessels: the long-range comfort of the Absolute Navetta 62 trawler yacht; the high-speed performance of the Mystic M4200 (PBIBS 2025) center console with raceboat heritage; and the elegant Sirena 48 Coupe (PBIBS 2025), an owner-operated yacht known for its efficient hull and open design.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 192
programme.desc: This episode is dedicated to performance and versatility, highlighting the 50-knot Italian maxi-RIB Mar.co E44 with its luxury cabin. It also covers three premier US fishing boats: the wide-beamed Southport 38 FE (PBIBS 2025), the serious offshore Bertram 39 CC (PBIBS 2025), and the versatile hybrid bay boat Blackfin 262 HB (MIBS 2025).

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 193
programme.desc: This episode covers Italian design and high performance, featuring the stylish Ranieri Sauvage 34 luxury RIB and the premier charter offerings of Spartivento. This is contrasted with the high-speed thrill of the Cigarette 41 Nighthawk SD, a performance center console with a new stepped-deck design.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 194
programme.desc: This episode features the sleek De Antonio D60, a 60-foot Spanish yacht renowned for its clean deck and hidden outboards, alongside a look at the innovative Euthalia lightning protection system. Finally, it highlights the powerful, recently updated Robalo R300 CC (PBIBS 2025), a 30-foot center console built for serious offshore fishing with an aggressive Deep-V hull.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 195
programme.desc: This episode features the luxury and speed of the Celebration for the 40th anniversary of Pershing in Capri, alongside the superyacht prowess of Heesen Yachts' Agnetha, a 55-meter yacht with a 4,500 NM range. It concludes with the rugged, unsinkable performance of the Everglades 315 CC (PBIBS 2025), a premium offshore center console.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 196
programme.desc: This segment showcases three impressive boats: the Ranieri International Cayman 50, a 50-foot luxury maxi-RIB capable of 55 knots; the Italian icon Riva 58 Capri, a new sport-open yacht blending high-speed performance and classic elegance; and the Bayliner V36 (PBIBS 2025), a versatile express cruiser known for maximizing family cruising space.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 189
programme.desc: The segment features the Best of Motor Boats at Genoa Boat Show 2025, highlighting top Italian and global innovations. This is contrasted with the high-capacity, versatile Hurricane 3200 Sundeck (MIBS 2025), and the luxurious downeast-style Back Cove 39O (MIBS 2025)

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 190
programme.desc: This segment offers a dramatic contrast, featuring the international excellence and new launches from the Best of Sailing Boats at Genoa Boat Show 2025 alongside two high-performance American powerboats at MIBS: the massive, quint-engine HCB 56 Sueños GIX, a center console yacht with 3,000 HP and luxury amenities, and the versatile Pursuit S328 Sport, which perfectly balances serious offshore fishing with premium family cruising and comfort.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Western Australia Margaret River Pro 2025
programme.desc: The Western Australia Margaret River Pro is the 7th stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, running from May 17 to May 27. This crucial event marks the mid-season decider, where the world's best surfers put it all on the line to advance through the next section of the tour. It is also the third and final stop of the GWM Aussie Treble. Margaret River will bring the action with pumping waves and strong competition.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

programme.sub-title: Wolves' Weddings | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 2
programme.desc: Sam, Lucy, and Erwan head to the naturally beautiful Kabyle region along with locals Dihya Nasri and Walid Assef. Once there, they surf some clean, cold, and completely uncrowded peelers and get some famous ice cream in Béjaïa, a market city known for its rich music scene, vibrant clothing, and incredible views of the Sapphire Coast. They then explore the stunning Cap Carbon headlands and learn about the native Berber culture and ancient Kabyle language.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: Known as the quintessential party music, Polka is alive and evolving in the great city of Milwaukee. From buttonboxes to beers and brats, this is a city full of personality and a deep love for its musical heritage.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: Kansas City, Missouri, is an integral part of jazz history in America. Shaped by legends who once graced its streets, it is bursting with deep history, mouth-watering cuisine and a lively jazz scene. World-renowned trumpeter, tap dancer, and entertainer, Lonnie McFadden and celebrated singer and tap dancer Chloe McFadden, show Chunz and Makh what it’s all about. From finger-licking barbecue to sports events and a bustling nightlife, this city is a cultural hub offering endless opportunities for a fun-filled getaway.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Falls: Testament Of Love
programme.desc: The Falls: Testament of Love is a continuation of the story of RJ Smith and Chris Merrill, two Mormon missionaries that fell in love during their mission in a small town in Oregon. The boys haven't spoken in five years, but when an unexpected tragedy compells them back to the Oregon town where they served, they find themselves, once again, thrust into one another's lives. As old feelings begin to surface they find themselves again facing difficult choices. If they pursue their desire to be together, RJ and Chris risk hurting the ones they care about as they embark on a spiritual journey to discover love, freedom, and happiness.

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Escandalos - Asuntos de Familia
programme.desc: El hijo de una famosa autora de libros de autoayuda es sospechoso en el caso de la muerte de una joven que salía con él. Sus padres, por protegerlo, alterarán pruebas circunstanciales, complicando más el caso para la policía.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Adan descubrio donde esta Ida. Y lara planifica su retorno a la Television

programme.title: Un Papa Para Navidad
programme.desc: Rebeca es una estrella de las redes. Se ha dejado encandilar de tal manera por la fama y el reconocimiento que su familia ha pasado a segundo plano. Pero una navidad un desconocido se presenta en su puerta afirmando que es su padre. Y aquel encuentro ayudará a Rebeca a recuperar lo verdaderamente importante en la vida.

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: La Mejor Navidad
programme.desc: Desde su divorcio, la ambiciosa Gloria ha dedicado todo su tiempo y su atención a su trabajo en Miami. Incluso sus hijos han pasado a un segundo plano. Cuando las circunstancias la obligan a pasar una navidad en familia en el rancho de su exmarido Eduardo en un pequeño pueblo de Jalisco, descubre que la felicidad y el amor suelen esconderse en las cosas más simples.

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.desc: El hijo de una famosa autora de libros de autoayuda es sospechoso en el caso de la muerte de una joven que salía con él. Sus padres, por protegerlo, alterarán pruebas circunstanciales, complicando más el caso para la policía.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Commando 3
programme.desc: Commando 3 is an action-packed thriller that follows Karanveer Singh Dogra (played by Vidyut Jammwal), an elite Indian commando, who is sent on a mission to London to track down and eliminate a terrorist threat. As he uncovers a deadly plot aimed at dividing India on religious lines, he must use his combat skills and intelligence to protect his country. With high-octane stunts, intense chase sequences, and a patriotic theme, the film keeps audiences on edge. Directed by Aditya Datt, it’s the third installment in the Commando series.

programme.title: Good Boy Bad Boy
programme.desc: Directed by Ashwini Chaudhary, this coming-of-age drama features Emraan Hashmi and Tusshar Kapoor as students with contrasting personalities. When they switch places, chaos ensues, affecting their academic and personal lives. The film is a remake of the 1992 movie Class Act.

programme.title: A Flying Jatt
programme.desc: Aman, a martial arts teacher, discovers his superpowers when he engages in a fight with Raka, a mercenary. However, Raka is exposed to toxic waste and becomes more powerful and Aman must defeat him.

programme.title: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
programme.desc: Saher, a video blogger, embarks on a solo trip to expose Karan, the owner of a tourism company she believes is a fraud. They both start off on a bitter note but gradually fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Commando 3

programme.title: Kanjoos Makhichoos
programme.desc: A man covertly saves money to fulfil his father's desire to go on the Char Dham Yatra. However, things change when his parents go missing due to heavy floods.

programme.title: Tejas
programme.desc: Indian Air Force officer Tejas sets out on a dangerous mission to rescue an Indian spy from Pakistan. As she faces off against the adversaries that come her way, she finds herself also fighting the ghosts of her past.

programme.title: Chhatriwali
programme.desc: An unemployed chemistry genius is on a quest to use her expertise to help students to overcome the taboo associated with sex and the human reproductory system.

programme.title: Parmanu - The Story of Pokhran
programme.desc: Based on true events, Parmanu – The Story of Pokhran follows the journey of a dedicated IAS officer, Ashwat Raina, who leads a top-secret mission to conduct India’s first underground nuclear tests in 1998 at Pokhran, Rajasthan. Battling political opposition, espionage threats, and tight deadlines, the team works against all odds to place India on the world’s nuclear map. The film is a patriotic thriller about courage, strategy, and national honor.
